_note: 18 distinct milestones. 'flags' are suggested boolean/numeric modifiers to set on player state. In Phase 7, every milestone claimed at least once this turn is removed from the game for everyone else.

milestones.name: First billboard placed
milestones.effect: No marketeer salaries; your campaigns become eternal (marketeer removed for the game).

milestones.name: First to train someone
milestones.trigger: train an employee to a higher level

milestones.name: First to hire three people in one turn
milestones.effect: Immediately gain 2 Management Trainee cards on the beach.

milestones.name: First burger marketed
milestones.effect: +$5 per burger sold (bonus, not unit price; not doubled by gardens; boosted by CFO).

milestones.name: First drink marketed
milestones.trigger: place a campaign advertising any drink
milestones.effect: +$5 per drink sold, all drink types.

milestones.name: First errand boy played
milestones.trigger: play an errand boy in your structure
milestones.effect: Buyers +1 drink per source; errand boys bring 2 identical drinks.

milestones.name: First to have $20
milestones.trigger: have $20 cash at any time (after income, before salaries)
milestones.effect: May look at face-down reserve cards (may bluff, may not show).

milestones.name: First burger produced
milestones.effect: Immediately receive a Burger Cook card (cannot train it this turn).

milestones.name: First pizza produced
milestones.effect: Immediately receive a Pizza Cook card (cannot train it this turn).

milestones.name: First waitress played
milestones.trigger: play a waitress in your structure

milestones.name: First airplane campaign
milestones.effect: When determining order of play, count +2 open slots.

milestones.name: First to lower prices
milestones.trigger: play a pricing manager or discount manager

milestones.name: First to have $100
milestones.trigger: have >=$100 cash at the end of Phase 4
milestones.effect: CEO also acts as CFO (+50% cash at end of Phase 4). Fire any CFO in Phase 5; may not train a CFO after. Effective next turn.

milestones.name: First radio campaign
milestones.effect: Radio places 2 goods per reached house in Phase 6 (0/1 if nearly full). Immediate.

milestones.name: First to throw away drink/food
milestones.trigger: throw away 1+ food/drink token in Phase 7
milestones.effect: Card becomes a freezer: store up to 10 tokens across turns (not usable the turn gained).

milestones.name: First to pay $20 or more in salaries
milestones.trigger: actually pay >=$20 in salaries in Phase 5 (discounts don't count; all discounts must be used first)
milestones.effect: May use multiple trainers/coaches/gurus on the same person.
